Sub 'WriteData'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
For each trnscardapiogrupo order carGruDescricao when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruDescricao) when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carGruCodigo when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruCodigo) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carGruCozinhaCentral when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruCozinhaCentral) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carGruStatus when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruStatus) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
using trnscardapiogrupoWWDS(&DynamicFiltersSelector1, &DynamicFiltersOperator1, &carGruCodigo1, &carGruDescricao1, &carDapDescricao1, &carGruCozinhaCentral1 , &carGruStatus1, &DynamicFiltersEnabled2, &DynamicFiltersSelector2, &DynamicFiltersOperator2, &carGruCodigo2, &carGruDescricao2 , &carDapDescricao2, &carGruCozinhaCentral2, &carGruStatus2, &DynamicFiltersEnabled3, &DynamicFiltersSelector3, &DynamicFiltersOperator3 , &carGruCodigo3, &carGruDescricao3, &carDapDescricao3, &carGruCozinhaCentral3, &carGruStatus3, &TFcarGruCodigo , &TFcarGruCodigo_To, &TFcarGruDescricao, &TFcarGruDescricao_Sel, &TFcarGruCozinhaCentral_Sels, &TFcarGruStatus_Sels) Where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo
// Write cell values &CellRow += 1
Do 'BeforeWriteLine' &VisibleColumnCount = 0 For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True Do Case Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carGruCodigo' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = carGruCodigo Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carGruDescricao' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(carGruDescricao) Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carGruCozinhaCentral' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case carGruCozinhaCentral.ToString().Trim() = "N" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Não"
Case carGruCozinhaCentral.ToString().Trim() = "S" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Sim"
EndCase Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'carGruStatus' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case carGruStatus.ToString().Trim() = "A" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Ativo"
Case carGruStatus.ToString().Trim() = "I" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Inativo"
EndCase EndCase &VisibleColumnCount += 1 EndIf EndFor
Do 'AfterWriteLine'
Endfor
